interpretations.exact_text: A lithe, active figure holds a sword upright in both hands, while in the act of swift walking. He is passing over rugged land, and about his way the clouds are collocated wildly. He is alert and lithe, looking this way and that, as if an expected enemy might appear at any moment.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Swords, Page
